items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022

ctx.x: It’s been wonderful you know. I came into that band as the baby. Doc [Vollmer] came to one of the sessions, the jam sessions at the union hall and that’s where he heard me, and he liked what I was doing and he spoke with me, and he pulled me in as a back-up or a sub for Fred.

Because Fred was, his health was starting to be more challenged, you know, and that was — and Joey Morant was there and Art Baron on trombone. Now Art had played with, in the Ellington band when Duke was still leading it, and he’s got a lot of experience and stories and a great musician. Jackie [Williams], and Jackie on drums. The stories these cats had, and you learn man, it’s all about learning. Zeke Mullins — Zeke was Hamp’s piano player for what 20-some years? You know and Zeke, old Zeke man, they were really…
